title: SHINE YOUR LIGHT, EVEN WHEN YOU ARE CRITICISED

memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: “Blessed are you when people insult you, persecute you, and falsely say all kinds of evil against you because of Me.” (Matthew 5:11)

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
Elijah stood firmly for the truth, and because of that he was greatly opposed. He boldly confronted the idolatrous practices of the prophets of Baal. As a result, he became a target of persecution, criticism, and hostility. True prophets have always been those who face resistance.
Our Redeemer, Jesus Christ, is the One who faced the greatest opposition. False accusations, mockery, insults, and harsh criticism  He faced them all directly. Even while hanging on the cross in unbearable pain, He was treated without mercy. Yet, in that intense moment, He said:

“Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing.”

In these last days, Christians  especially true Christians will experience much opposition, hatred, and criticism. False accusations will come, and blame will be placed on us, exactly as Jesus foretold. But remember: we are the light of the world. Darkness can never overpower light.

Therefore, beloved, When you are opposed or mocked for Christ’s sake, do not be discouraged. It is a sign that you are walking in the very path of Elijah, the prophets, the apostles, and our Lord Jesus Himself.

This is the path that leads us to glory. Whenever you are resisted or criticised, remember you are shining as a light to the world.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: “If you do not love humble obedience more than escaping criticism, you cannot follow Christ.” (Leonard Ravenhill)

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, when criticism and opposition come, strengthen me to stand firm. Give me a heart filled with grace and forgiveness, even towards those who oppose me. Use me to shine Your light boldly in this world. Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: May the Lord give you the courage to stand strong even when criticism comes. May every false and hateful word spoken against you fade away in the light of your testimony-filled life.

recommended_book.label: Recommended Book
recommended_book.title: The Cost of Discipleship
recommended_book.author: Dietrich Bonhoeffer
recommended_book.quote: “Suffering is not an accident in the Christian life; it is the mark of true discipleship. The disciple who follows Christ must expect to share in His rejection, because fellowship with Jesus always includes the cross.”
